name: Streaming The Case For Self Regulation For The Digital Assets Industry 20141941F7
text: The case for self-regulation for the digital assets industry reports that self-regulation and SROs have been incorporated into legal frameworks to support effective and efficient capital-market development. This is institutionally consistent with Kaal's mixed mandatory-rule, market-solution, and private-ordering design. The abstract proposition does not measure adaptive capacity, collective-action effects, or regulatory-cycle dampening.
